_about: Skyglass Wreck build spec (harness output; not pushed). Per version: AI dungeon copies (stats, pools, level, multipliers, effect rows, jutsu, ordered rules) and the new dungeon-only jutsu (full records, animation placeholder ids from docs/design/SKYGLASS_BOSS_ANIMATIONS.md and SKYGLASS_BOSS_FIGHTS.md). Harness ids (dg-*) are placeholders: the builder mints real ids, and rule jutsuId references must be remapped to them. Generated by harness/skyglass_wreck_sim/engine/build_kits.ts.
schemas: validated against the live validators at engine pin c86f43f4 (validators/combat.ts JutsuValidator, validators/ai.ts AiRule, validators/coordinateTargeting.ts via JutsuValidator)
